question: Which is the largest non-polar desert in the World?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sahara__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The largest Non-Polar desert in the world is** Sahara__**.
 
• Sahara desert spans across North Africa.
 
• **Largestdesert** is **Polardesert** is **Antarctica**.
 
• **KalahariDesert** is found in **Namibia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea728f908b060e4db8cdc0f37188bd8bacc49aff99cc89b07517095538ec56de.png] 

 
• **Gobi desert** is a cold desert found in **China and Mongolia. (Not only in China)**
